# Predicted SI by edatopic position and site series
This script uses the SIBEC machine-learned models to predict site index by edatopic position for each BGC and tree species. Predictions are made on a synthetic data set representing all edatopic conditions for each BGC. 100 climate points per BGC are selected randomly from a 2km grid of the WNA_BGC. At each of these climate points, 40 edatopic sites (A-E SNR by 0-7 rSMR) are created with site adjusted climate and site level attributes.  A tree species specific site index by edatopic grid is then generated for review and model improvement.
A table of predicted site index for site series is then summarized from edatopic SI50 of all edatopic positions for each site series.

##Import Edatopic Predictions generated in SIBEC_tables_predicted script

```{r}
all_species_grids <- readRDS( "./edatopic_preds/species_grids_all_models.rds"
)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

# Models to compare
model_names <- c(
  "rf",
  "xgb",
  "svm",
  "gam",
  "stack",
  "meta"
)

# Extract rSMR = 4 / SNR = 3 from every model
plot_dat <- map_dfr(
  model_names,
  function(model_name) {

    model_grids <- all_species_grids[[model_name]]

    imap_dfr(
      model_grids,
      function(spp_list, species) {

        imap_dfr(
          spp_list,
          function(bgc_tbl, bgc) {

            bgc_tbl %>%
              filter(rSMR == 4) %>%
              transmute(
                TreeSpp = species,
                BGC = bgc,
                Model = toupper(model_name),
                SI50 = as.numeric(`3`)
              )
          }
        )
      }
    )
  }
) %>%
  filter(is.finite(SI50))
```

```{r}
#---------------------------------------
# Mean climate values by BGC
#---------------------------------------
sibec.anal <- readRDS("./data/SIBEC_Analysis_data_2026.rds")
climate_vars <- c(
  "CMD.adj",
  "DD5_an",
  "CMI_an",
  "DD18_an",
  "Eref_an",
  "PAS_an",
  "bFFP",
  "VPD_sm"
)

bgc_climate <- sibec.anal %>%
  group_by(BGC) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(climate_vars),
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```




Plot examples of SI for species by BGC for all models

```{r}
tree.choose = "Cw" ; bgc.choose = "^IDF|^ICH|^SBS|^CWH"#"CWH" ## "^SBS|^ICH|^IDF" # "^ESSF|^MH|^BAFA"
tree_dat <- plot_dat %>%
  filter(    TreeSpp == tree.choose,
    grepl(bgc.choose, BGC)  )
bgc_order <- tree_dat %>%
  filter(Model == "STACK") %>%  arrange(SI50) %>%  pull(BGC)
tree_dat <- tree_dat %>%
  mutate(BGC = factor(BGC,levels = bgc_order)) %>%
  arrange(Model, BGC)
ggplot( tree_dat,
  aes(x = BGC,  y = SI50, colour = Model, group = Model)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7,alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point( size = 1.8) +
  labs(
    x = "BGC",
    y = "Predicted site index (SI50)",
    title = paste(tree.choose, " SI50 at rSMR 4 and SNR C"),
    colour = "Model") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 6,
      angle = 90,
      vjust = 0.5,
      hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

```
compare SI across all models and species for individual BGC zonals.
We might be able to assess how well models are doing by examining the co-occurence of species in natural plots where shade-intolerant species with similar high SI will co-occur and others will be excluded.

Compare multiple models for species in a single BGC
See impact of models and maybe help decide on best model choice and model issues.

```{r}
bgc.choose <- "CDFmm"

bgc_dat <- plot_dat %>%
  filter(BGC == bgc.choose)

# Order species by META-predicted SI50
spp_order <- bgc_dat %>%
  filter(Model == "STACK") %>%
  arrange(SI50) %>%
  pull(TreeSpp)

bgc_dat <- bgc_dat %>%
  mutate(
    TreeSpp = factor(
      TreeSpp,
      levels = unique(spp_order)
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Model, TreeSpp)

ggplot(
  bgc_dat,
  aes(
    x = TreeSpp,
    y = SI50,
    colour = Model,
    group = Model
  )
) +
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.8
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Tree species",
    y = "Predicted site index (SI50)",
    title = paste(
      bgc.choose,
      "SI50 at rSMR 4 and SNR C"
    ),
    colour = "Model"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      vjust = 0.5,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
#Single model output for multiple species across multiple BGC organized by chosen species SI50
Could compare this result against actual species occurrence in BGCs.
Expect that the dominant shade intolerant species should be fairly close in dominant SI and those with significantly lower SI will not appear in natural stands.

Could then check a change is relationship between species between 1961-1990 and current time period to support species additions now and then future trajectories to see either critical fails or increasing spread of SI
```{r}
model.choose <- "STACK"
bgc.choose <- "^ESSF"#|^ICH|^SBS
test.spp <- c("Pl", "Sx", "Bl", "Py", "Lw", "At", "Fd", "Pw")

model_dat <- plot_dat %>%
  filter(
    Model == model.choose,
    grepl(bgc.choose, BGC),
    TreeSpp %in% c(test.spp)
  )

# Order BGCs by Pl SI50
bgc_order <- model_dat %>%
  filter(TreeSpp == "Pl") %>%
  arrange(SI50) %>%
  pull(BGC) %>%
  unique()

model_dat <- model_dat %>%
  mutate(
    BGC = factor(BGC, levels = bgc_order)
  ) %>%
  arrange(TreeSpp, BGC)

ggplot(
  model_dat,
  aes(
    x = BGC,
    y = SI50,
    colour = TreeSpp,
    group = TreeSpp
  )
) +
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  labs(
    x = "BGC",
    y = "Predicted site index (SI50)",
    title = paste(
      model.choose,
      "SI50 at rSMR 4 and SNR C organized by Pl SI50"
    ),
    colour = "Species"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 6,
      angle = 90,
      vjust = 0.5,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

Organize single species by climate metric
Look for single metric relationship to SI50. Possibly find climate surface problems
```{r}
tree.choose <- "Sx"
bgc.choose <- "^IDF|^ICH|^SBS|^BG|^BWBS"
climate.choose <- "CMD.adj"

tree_dat <- plot_dat %>%
  filter(
    TreeSpp == tree.choose,
    grepl(bgc.choose, BGC)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    bgc_climate,
    by = "BGC"
  )
bgc_order <- tree_dat %>%
  distinct(
    BGC,
    climate_value = .data[[climate.choose]]
  ) %>%
  arrange(climate_value) %>%
  pull(BGC)

tree_dat <- tree_dat %>%
  mutate(
    BGC = factor(
      BGC,
      levels = bgc_order
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Model, BGC)
ggplot(
  tree_dat,
  aes(
    x = BGC,
    y = SI50,
    colour = Model,
    group = Model
  )
) +
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.8
  ) +
  labs(
    x = paste(
      "BGC ordered by mean",
      climate.choose
    ),
    y = "Predicted site index (SI50)",
    title = paste(
      tree.choose,
      "SI50 at rSMR 4 and SNR C"
    ),
    colour = "Model"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 6,
      angle = 90,
      vjust = 0.5,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

```
